hypothetical_business_scenarios.detail: Individual, small-clinic, and institution cases are explicitly hypothetical and make no market-size, revenue, pricing, or demand claims.

release_support_and_model_limitations.detail: Release-note template, changelog policy, support FAQ, escalation steps, and user-visible model limitations are present.

fhir_r4_documentreference.detail: Direct serializer test verifies DocumentReference type, note ID, approval digest identifier, encounter, attachment content, and approval binding. No EHR certification is claimed.

buyer_security_checklist_and_data_flow.detail: Buyer checklist, deployment owners/dependencies, logical data flow, and operator responsibilities are documented.

investor_demo_outline.detail: Ten-slide outline uses synthetic reproducible material and separates measured evidence from unknowns.

simulated_feedback_and_reprioritization.detail: Five records are labeled simulated, not customer quotes; reprioritization rules require evidence class and owner.

roadmap_evidence_scorecard.detail: Feature maturity, simulated usage, research evidence, and external validation are shown in separate columns.

launch_authorization_boundary.detail: Agent recommendation is explicitly separated from institutional authorization and real-patient release remains blocked.

limitations: Commercial scenarios and feedback are simulated, not customer findings.
FHIR output is a prototype serializer, not an EHR integration or certification.
No clinical or purchaser validation was performed.
